category_title: High-achieving bilingual Latino fifth-graders who disassociate from academic labels through mischievous behaviors
scenario_title: Science Class Discussion During Principal's Visit
minimal_context: The student is in science class and the teacher asks the class to explain their current activity to the visiting principal.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The principal is visiting our science class today. She asked what we are doing. Who can answer?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Exaggeratedly turns his head away) I’m distracted…. I can’t concentrate…. I have ADD, Miss!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's try to focus on the principal's question about our science activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I know what we are doing! (Starts saying everything about the science activity)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Screams out) But I know the rest! (Continues to say everything he knows loudly)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: The principal is visiting our science class today. She asked what we are doing. Who can answer?

STUDENT: (Exaggeratedly turns his head away) I’m distracted…. I can’t concentrate…. I have ADD, Miss!

TUTOR: Let's try to focus on the principal's question about our science activity.

STUDENT: I know what we are doing! (Starts saying everything about the science activity)

TUTOR: Okay. Let other people talk.

STUDENT: (Screams out) But I know the rest! (Continues to say everything he knows loudly)
